media_registry.content: The study and shaping of governance systems - including norms, policies, laws, processes, politics, and institutions - that affect the research, development, deployment, and use of existing and future AI systems in ways that positively shape societal outcomes. It encompasses both research into effective governance approaches and the practical implementation of these approaches.
